name: ahood
description: ahood in Codex: the registry's MCP tools (search, fetch, publish skills, agents, MCP servers, docs), plus the ahood skill to find, try and install artifacts, use prompts and loops, publish, star, see your stats, sync updates, review evolution proposals and capture private snaps.

interface.shortDescription: ahood's registry MCP tools, plus a skill to find, install and publish artifacts, sync, review and snap
interface.longDescription: ahood (ahood.dev) is a registry for AI agent skills, agents, MCP servers and docs, with versioning, private session notes (snaps) and owner-approved self-evolution. This plugin wires up ahood's hosted MCP server (it reads your token from $AHOOD_TOKEN) and bundles two skills: `ahood`, a hub for finding, trying, installing and publishing artifacts that syncs updates and reviews evolution proposals only with your consent, and `using-ahood`, how to search, install and snap from inside a session.
